introduction: ERC-6059 defines an interface for nestable non-fungible tokens, extending ERC-721 so that an NFT can be owned by another NFT instead of only by an account or contract. It was proposed by Bruno Škvorc, Cicada, Steven Pineda, Stevan Bogosavljevic, and Jan Turk in November 2022. A parent token owns child tokens, and the parent's root owner governs them: a child is first proposed into a pending array and must be accepted before it becomes active, giving the owner full control over what a token holds.
designPurpose: ERC-6059 was designed to standardize token-owned-token relationships that ERC-721 alone cannot express. Before it, bundling NFTs from different collections, grouping tokens under one owner, or delegating them needed custom escrow contracts or off-chain bookkeeping that no common tooling understood. The standard adds a propose-commit pattern where anyone may propose a child but only the parent's root owner can accept, reject, or transfer it, while ownerOf resolves recursively to the top-level account.
commonUsage: Nestable NFTs are used to bundle several collectibles into one sellable token, to group tokens under a root NFT such as the legs of a shipping container's journey, to nest-mint membership or reward tokens into a holder's existing NFT, and to delegate voting NFTs by nesting them into a chosen delegate. Because the standard stays backward compatible with ERC-721, implementations reuse existing ERC-721 tooling, advertise support through ERC-165, and layer pending and active child arrays over a standard collection.
fn.ownerOf.desc: Returns the root owner of tokenId, the top-level owner in the hierarchy that is not itself an NFT. When the token is owned by another NFT, it recursively resolves up through the parents until it reaches a non-NFT owner.
fn.ownerOf.params.tokenId: The token whose root owner is being retrieved.
fn.ownerOf.returns.owner: The root owner of the token.
fn.directOwnerOf.desc: Returns the immediate owner of tokenId. When the direct owner is another token, the returned address is that parent's collection contract, parentId is its token ID, and the flag signals that the owner is an NFT.
fn.directOwnerOf.params.tokenId: The token whose direct owner is being retrieved.
fn.directOwnerOf.returns.owner: Address of the token's immediate owner; the parent's collection contract when the owner is an NFT.
fn.directOwnerOf.returns.parentId: ID of the parent token, or 0 when the owner is not an NFT.
fn.directOwnerOf.returns.isNft: True when the immediate owner is an NFT, false otherwise.
fn.burn.desc: Burns tokenId and recursively burns its child tokens, up to maxRecursiveBurns. It reverts if more children remain than the limit allows; a value of 0 burns only the token and reverts if it still has any children.
fn.burn.params.maxRecursiveBurns: Maximum number of child tokens to recursively burn.
fn.burn.returns.burnedChildren: The number of child tokens that were recursively burned.
fn.addChild.desc: Adds a child token to the parent token's pending children array. It is called by another nestable contract during a nest transfer, and the child's directOwnerOf must resolve to the calling contract.
fn.addChild.params.parentId: ID of the parent token that receives the new child token.
fn.addChild.params.childId: ID of the new proposed child token.
fn.acceptChild.desc: Moves a pending child token into the parent token's active children array. The expected child address and ID are passed alongside its index to guard against the index shifting before the call executes.
fn.acceptChild.params.parentId: ID of the parent token whose child is being accepted.
fn.acceptChild.params.childIndex: Index of the child token in the pending children array.
fn.acceptChild.params.childAddress: Expected collection contract of the child token at that index.
fn.acceptChild.params.childId: Expected ID of the child token at that index.
fn.rejectAllChildren.desc: Removes all pending child tokens of the parent token from its pending array. maxRejections caps how many are rejected so a child added just before the call is not silently discarded; exceeding it reverts.
fn.rejectAllChildren.params.parentId: ID of the parent token whose pending children are rejected.
fn.rejectAllChildren.params.maxRejection: Maximum number of pending children expected to be rejected.
fn.transferChild.desc: Transfers a child token out of the parent token, removing it from the active or pending array. Depending on the parameters it can reject, abandon, unnest to an account, or move the child into a new parent token.
fn.transferChild.params.tokenId: ID of the parent token the child is being transferred from.
fn.transferChild.params.to: Address to which the child token is transferred.
fn.transferChild.params.destinationId: ID of the token to receive the child, or 0 when the destination is not a token.
fn.transferChild.params.childIndex: Index of the child token in the array it is being moved from.
fn.transferChild.params.childAddress: Collection contract of the child token.
fn.transferChild.params.childId: ID of the child token in its own collection.
fn.transferChild.params.isPending: True when the child is in the pending array, false when in the active array.
fn.transferChild.params.data: Additional data with no specified format, forwarded in the call to the recipient.
fn.nestTransferFrom.desc: Transfers a token into another token, nesting it as a child. The destination must not be the token being transferred or one of its downstream children, which would create an ownership loop.
fn.nestTransferFrom.params.from: Address of the current direct owner of the token being transferred.
fn.nestTransferFrom.params.to: Address of the receiving token's collection contract.
fn.nestTransferFrom.params.tokenId: ID of the token being transferred into another token.
fn.nestTransferFrom.params.destinationId: ID of the parent token that receives the transferred token.
fn.NestTransfer.desc: Emitted when a token is transferred between immediate owners. fromTokenId and toTokenId identify the previous and new parent tokens, and are 0 when the token was not or is not being nested.
fn.NestTransfer.params.from: Address of the previous immediate owner, a collection contract when the token was nested.
fn.NestTransfer.params.to: Address of the new immediate owner, a collection contract when the token is being nested.
fn.NestTransfer.params.fromTokenId: ID of the previous parent token, or 0 if the token was not nested before.
fn.NestTransfer.params.toTokenId: ID of the new parent token, or 0 if the token is not being nested.
fn.NestTransfer.params.tokenId: ID of the token being transferred.
fn.ChildProposed.desc: Emitted when a new child token is added to a parent token's pending children array, awaiting acceptance by the root owner.
fn.ChildProposed.params.tokenId: ID of the token that received a new pending child token.
fn.ChildProposed.params.childIndex: Index of the proposed child token in the pending children array.
fn.ChildProposed.params.childAddress: Collection contract of the proposed child token.
fn.ChildProposed.params.childId: ID of the child token in its own collection.
fn.ChildAccepted.desc: Emitted when a parent token accepts a pending child, migrating it from the pending array into the active children array.
fn.ChildAccepted.params.tokenId: ID of the token that accepted a new child token.
fn.ChildAccepted.params.childIndex: Index of the newly accepted child token in the active children array.
fn.ChildAccepted.params.childAddress: Collection contract of the child token.
fn.ChildAccepted.params.childId: ID of the child token in its own collection.
fn.AllChildrenRejected.desc: Emitted when all pending child tokens of a token are removed from its pending array in a single rejection.
fn.AllChildrenRejected.params.tokenId: ID of the token whose pending children were all rejected.
fn.ChildTransferred.desc: Emitted when a child token is transferred out of a parent token, from either its pending or active array, changing the child's ownership.
fn.ChildTransferred.params.tokenId: ID of the token that transferred a child token.
fn.ChildTransferred.params.childIndex: Index of the child in the array it is being transferred from.
fn.ChildTransferred.params.childAddress: Collection contract of the child token.
fn.ChildTransferred.params.childId: ID of the child token in its own collection.
fn.ChildTransferred.params.fromPending: True when the child was in the pending array, false when in the active array.
sim.nestAcceptWalkthrough.name: Nest and Accept a Child
sim.nestAcceptWalkthrough.desc: Follow a child NFT as it is nested into a parent token, lands in the pending array, and is accepted by the root owner into the active array.
sim.nestAcceptWalkthrough.step.nest: The root owner calls nestTransferFrom to transfer the child token into the parent token, starting the nesting process.
sim.nestAcceptWalkthrough.step.propose: The parent contract adds the child to its pending children array and emits ChildProposed; the child is not yet active.
sim.nestAcceptWalkthrough.step.accept: The parent token's root owner calls acceptChild, passing the child's index, address, and ID to confirm the expected token.
sim.nestAcceptWalkthrough.step.commit: The contract moves the child from the pending array into the active children array and emits ChildAccepted.
